title: Upper Deck: launch questions
lede: Veronica answered the Upper Deck questions on September 9. Thank you. Two things are left. Each part sends itself to Nicholas a few seconds after you stop typing and keeps a copy on your phone.

qs.t: Four items marked "fixed prices": L434, UAL128, UDXL201, UT906. What should each show?
qs.w: "Fixed" didn't tell us the number. Type the right single price and, if there is one, the right quantity price (example: 27.50 / 4+ 26.50), or ONE if there should be no quantity price.

qs.t: Anything you would change in Veronica's answers?
qs.w: She ruled on September 9: $250 counted after quantity discounts (never shipping) and $75 for showroom pickup · no card taken on the website, charged once when the order ships, net-30 accounts by check · every Min. item: the minimum, then any number · orders sync into the office system (LMS, backup VXP) · no one sees prices or orders until approved · hours Mon–Thu 8–3 · keep the checkout pickup switch, drop the cart question.
